decisions.reason: As a newly launched core process-equipment product with dedicated web presentation, it fits the firm's stated innovation path and the management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course after only one year.

This resin injection unit also represents a visible recent investment in the firm's core application technology, so escalation of commitment and normal industrial product-cycle patience both favor retention.
An automatic airless spray gun is close to the firm's established spray-equipment business, making it strategically central and unlikely to be withdrawn quickly absent clear failure evidence.

The manual airless spray gun sits squarely within the company's traditional offering, and management would usually keep such a recently introduced product on the market while building adoption through its sales and service network.

Because this is a broader product line with several models and a dedicated market presence, the firm has made an especially visible commitment and is therefore even less likely to pull it within a year.

The data logger is somewhat more adjacent to the firm's core mechanical equipment business, but it still supports the announced direction toward innovative application technology, so management is more likely to persist than to abandon it quickly.
